jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. jobs.prompt:

Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.

The subjects below correspond to catalogue cards, but NEVER PRINT their names or identifiers. Paint precisely in reading order:
ROW 1, left to right: CELL 1: ivory star-antlered stag, turning toward the viewer amid drifting leaves, front three-quarter view, wearing light crownlike antlers or decorative crest and orbiting fireflies; turquoise cascades through an ancestral sanctuary. Powerful mature creature, elaborate flowing silhouette. Palette: ivory/gold, starlit azure.
CELL 2: sleek turquoise river fox with flowing multiple tails, turning toward the viewer amid drifting leaves, full-body diagonal action view, wearing antique shoulder plates and small ancestral bells; a coral garden of floating golden terraces. Powerful mature creature, elaborate flowing silhouette. Palette: ivory/gold, turquoise and sapphire.

Powerful mature creature, elaborate flowing silhouette. Palette: ivory/gold, coral and vermilion.

NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.

jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.

The subjects below correspond to catalogue cards, but NEVER PRINT their names or identifiers. Paint precisely in reading order:
ROW 1, left to right: CELL 1: crab-dragon with articulated claws, segmented tail and multiple horns, standing alert on a high windblown ledge, side view with the face turned toward the viewer, wearing antique shoulder plates and small ancestral bells; a violet moonlit grove with giant flowering roots. Agile young creature with finely drawn anatomy. Palette: ivory/gold, starlit azure.
CELL 2: two-headed wolf-crane with contrasting fur and long feather crests, standing alert on a high windblown ledge, dramatic elevated three-quarter view, wearing curling botanical engravings and crystal-tipped plumes; a shattered crystal canyon crossed by a silver stream. Agile young creature with finely drawn anatomy. Palette: ivory/gold, turquoise and sapphire.
CELL 3: phoenix-stag with enormous feathered wings and branching antlers, standing alert on a high windblown ledge, front three-quarter view, wearing a flowing two-tone mantle and linked gold rings; a vast cloud citadel seen from a hanging bridge. Agile young creature with finely drawn anatomy. Palette: ivory/gold, coral and vermilion.
CELL 4: sea dragon-lion with a flowing fin mane and powerful clawed limbs, standing alert on a high windblown ledge, full-body diagonal action view, wearing a delicate engraved neck harness and long silk ribbons; sunken library arches lit by luminous fish. Agile young creature with finely drawn anatomy. Palette: ivory/gold, jade and mint.
CELL 5: wolf-griffin with layered feather wings and a long streaming tail, standing alert on a high windblown ledge, rear three-quarter view with visible expressive face, wearing layered scale armor with small floating gemstones; a copper and jade forge carved into living stone. Agile young creature with finely drawn anatomy. Palette: ivory/gold, rose and lilac.

jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.

The subjects below correspond to catalogue cards, but NEVER PRINT their names or identifiers. Paint precisely in reading order:
ROW 1, left to right: CELL 1: a crown-shaped aurora reuniting two distant floating islands, happening in a vast cloud citadel seen from a hanging bridge; wide cinematic view with the creature large in the foreground; diagonal flow from upper left. Tiny ivory star-antlered stag figures establish scale and story. Palette: ivory/gold, starlit azure.

Tiny sleek turquoise river fox with flowing multiple tails figures establish scale and story. Palette: ivory/gold, turquoise and sapphire.

jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. jobs.prompt:

Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.

The subjects below correspond to catalogue cards, but NEVER PRINT their names or identifiers. Paint precisely in reading order:
ROW 1, left to right: CELL 1: ribbons of elemental energy weaving a protective canopy over beasts, happening in a shattered crystal canyon crossed by a silver stream; full-body diagonal action view; two intersecting arcs of light. Tiny ivory star-antlered stag figures establish scale and story. Palette: ivory/gold, starlit azure.
CELL 2: ribbons of elemental energy weaving a protective canopy over beasts, happening in a vast cloud citadel seen from a hanging bridge; rear three-quarter view with visible expressive face; two intersecting arcs of light. Tiny sleek turquoise river fox with flowing multiple tails figures establish scale and story. Palette: ivory/gold, turquoise and sapphire.
CELL 3: ribbons of elemental energy weaving a protective canopy over beasts, happening in sunken library arches lit by luminous fish; close dynamic view with the entire main silhouette inside the tile; two intersecting arcs of light. jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.

The subjects below correspond to catalogue cards, but NEVER PRINT their names or identifiers. Paint precisely in reading order:
ROW 1, left to right: CELL 1: a crown-shaped aurora reuniting two distant floating islands, happening in a ruined ivory observatory above an ocean of stars; low three-quarter view; a wide sweeping crescent. Tiny ivory star-antlered stag figures establish scale and story. Palette: ivory/gold, starlit azure.
CELL 2: a crown-shaped aurora reuniting two distant floating islands, happening in turquoise cascades through an ancestral sanctuary; side view with the face turned toward the viewer; a wide sweeping crescent. Tiny sleek turquoise river fox with flowing multiple tails figures establish scale and story. Palette: ivory/gold, turquoise and sapphire.
CELL 3: a crown-shaped aurora reuniting two distant floating islands, happening in a coral garden of floating golden terraces; dramatic elevated three-quarter view; a wide sweeping crescent. Tiny coral-maned red wolf with ember-patterned coat figures establish scale and story. Palette: ivory/gold, coral and vermilion.

jobs.prompt:

Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. jobs.prompt:

Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.

jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.

Agile young creature with finely drawn anatomy. Palette: indigo, cyan, ivory and pale gold; constellation tracery and orbital rings.

Agile young creature with finely drawn anatomy. Palette: violet, silver, lavender and dark blue; spectral memories and musical trails.
CELL 3: crimson armored rhinoceros, rearing or stretching upward beside a giant crystal, side view with the face turned toward the viewer, wearing a luminous chest crystal with trailing ceremonial cords; a copper and jade forge carved into living stone. jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.

jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.

jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.

The subjects below correspond to catalogue cards, but NEVER PRINT their names or identifiers. Paint precisely in reading order:
ROW 1, left to right: CELL 1: celestial eagle-lion griffin, leaping forward across a broken bridge, low three-quarter view, wearing a sweeping feather mantle and gilt anatomical markings; a ruined ivory observatory above an ocean of stars. Ancient majestic creature, large expressive silhouette and complex flowing details. Palette: indigo, cyan, ivory and pale gold; constellation tracery and orbital rings.

jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.

The subjects below correspond to catalogue cards, but NEVER PRINT their names or identifiers. Paint precisely in reading order:
ROW 1, left to right: CELL 1: star fox with three comet tails, standing alert on a high windblown ledge, side view with the face turned toward the viewer, wearing a flowing two-tone mantle and linked gold rings; a violet moonlit grove with giant flowering roots. Ancient majestic creature, large expressive silhouette and complex flowing details. Palette: indigo, cyan, ivory and pale gold; constellation tracery and orbital rings.
CELL 2: translucent dream whale, standing alert on a high windblown ledge, dramatic elevated three-quarter view, wearing a delicate engraved neck harness and long silk ribbons; a shattered crystal canyon crossed by a silver stream. Ancient majestic creature, large expressive silhouette and complex flowing details. Palette: violet, silver, lavender and dark blue; spectral memories and musical trails.

jobs.prompt:

Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.

Ancient majestic creature, large expressive silhouette and complex flowing details. Palette: indigo, cyan, ivory and pale gold; constellation tracery and orbital rings.

jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.

Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.

jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

jobs.prompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.
